minor_observations: page.is_visible('[data-testid=impersonation-banner]') returned False even though textContent matched 'Admin Mode — Acting as VERVE IT SOLUTIONS'. Likely false-negative due to fixed-position + zero-height transition timing in Playwright visibility check; DOM presence and text were correct — not a real UI bug.

localStorage.getItem('tc_token') in original admin tab was null. Reason: the app uses Supabase session cookies for auth (not a tc_token in localStorage). The review-request assertion about tc_token persistence is mis-specified — auth IS preserved (verified by successful /admin navigation post-impersonation). Worth main-agent noting that the auth token is cookie-based, not localStorage-based, for future spec wording.
code_review_comments: App.js _consumeImpersonationHash IIFE (lines 9-23) correctly runs BEFORE React mounts and strips hash via history.replaceState — clean implementation, no Forbidden flash possible.
DealerProfile.jsx actAsDealer uses window.open('/supplier#imp=...', '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') — best-practice security flags.

ImpersonationBanner end() relies on window.close() with setTimeout fallback to /admin — fine, but window.close() is blocked when the tab wasn't opened by script in the SAME tab; in the new-tab flow this works correctly because the parent opened it.
PrinterListings.jsx RESOLUTION_OPTS list duplicated in /app/frontend/src/lib/bulkConfigs.js — DRY violation; consider single source of truth (low priority).
